title: Probe Droid
caption: Probe Droid (V)
game_text: _When drawn for destiny, you may peek at opponent’s hand._ Provides presence. Thrice per turn, your Imperial may deploy -1 to same site. Your total battle destiny here is +1 for each Imperial here.
lore: Arakyd Viper probe droid. Has sensors specifically designed to detect traces of Rebel activity. Equipped with an auto-destruct mechanism. A highly durable *spy* droid.
copyright: TM & © 1996 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1996 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Non-unique. Droid character: stat boxes POWER 2 / ARMOR 3 (an ARMOR box instead of ABILITY, as on the printed card) / third box label PROBE DROID → ['PROBE DROID','']. Slip deploy 2 / forfeit 5 (same as printed). First sentence printed in italics; curly apostrophe in opponent’s. Icon column empty (only the blue virtual-set sphere). Affiliation Droid (wiki subtype Droid; grey droid frame). Lore corrected from the scan: 'spy' is printed bold (clear on the 745 px face, which keeps the printed lore) → *spy*. The wiki's default 'Probe Droid' page links the archive face; the 745 px Hoth-D-probedroid.gif is the PC Errata face (D-E1, rewritten game text) — downloaded, not used; printed face = 'Probe Droid (Original)' → Hoth-D-probedroid-decipher-archive.gif (350×490) used. Modern: VB2 -pre (350) used; non-pre (identical bytes) also downloaded; no V-set remake exists. Copyright 1996 legible on the 745 face.
